selection: All 37 Fukui Table 4 P-V-T observations and all 11 Table 1 ambient T-V observations. Table 1 P=0 GPa is the ambient-condition assumption, not a printed pressure measurement. No rows excluded, no Xia dataset mixed in, no pressure recalibration.

objectives.pressure: Unweighted sum over all 48 rows of [Pmodel(Vobs,Tobs)-Pobs]^2 [GPa^2]. Explicit baseline; V and T treated as exact predictors.
objectives.volume: Unweighted sum over all 48 rows of [Vmodel(Pobs,Tobs)-Vobs]^2 [A^6]. P and T treated as exact predictors. Invert on the local branch near observations; all fitted MGD models checked for positive bulk modulus.

mgd_definition.equation: P=BM3(V;V0,K0,Kprime)+1e-4*gamma(V)*[ED(V,T)-ED(V,300)]/Vmolar; gamma=gamma0*(V/V0)^q; theta=theta0*exp[-gamma0*((V/V0)^q-1)/q], with continuous q=0 limit; ED=3*n*R*T*D3(theta/T). Effective single-Debye spectrum, all six parameters fitted, no adopted literature theta.

empirical_definition: Same curved-expansion BM3 family as the current catalog variant, now jointly fitted to exactly the same 48 rows. Seven free parameters: V300,K300,Kprime300,alpha300,beta,K873,Kprime873. K and Kprime vary linearly between endpoints; V0(T)=V300*exp(alpha300*dT+0.5*beta*dT^2). Endpoint parameterization guarantees positive reference K over 300-873 K.

current_continuous.qualification: Only ambient expansion was fitted; published moduli and slopes adopted. Comparison with joint fits includes the effect of refitting compression parameters, not just changing EOS family.

mgd_pressure.covariance_qualification: Local SSE/(N-p) * inverse(J.T J); all row residuals unweighted. Ignores both-coordinate errors, pressure-scale systematics, model error and phase changes. Boundary optima invalidate symmetric confidence intervals.

mgd_volume.covariance_qualification: Local SSE/(N-p) * inverse(J.T J); all row residuals unweighted. Ignores both-coordinate errors, pressure-scale systematics, model error and phase changes. Boundary optima invalidate symmetric confidence intervals.

empirical_pressure.covariance_qualification: Local SSE/(N-p) * inverse(J.T J); all row residuals unweighted. Ignores both-coordinate errors, pressure-scale systematics, model error and phase changes. Boundary optima invalidate symmetric confidence intervals.

empirical_volume.covariance_qualification: Local SSE/(N-p) * inverse(J.T J); all row residuals unweighted. Ignores both-coordinate errors, pressure-scale systematics, model error and phase changes. Boundary optima invalidate symmetric confidence intervals.

interpretation_limits: These are in-sample residual comparisons; no external prediction or pressure-standard validation.
Current model used only 11 ambient fit rows; both new families use the same 48 joint rows. Matched empirical control has seven free parameters; MGD has six.
Single-Debye theta and gamma are effective fit coefficients, strongly objective-sensitive and correlated; no independent calorimetric or vibrational validation.
Full conditional covariance retained. Unweighted objectives do not use printed coordinate errors; no error-weighted, orthogonal-distance or pressure-scale systematic validation claimed.
Phase/H-order and dehydration limitations of the Fukui lattice-average observations persist. MGD fitting does not resolve phase equilibrium or justify extrapolation.
Diagnostic only: no catalog record, default or source coefficient changed.
